description: This file is a PHP class definition for managing categories within the OpenCart e-commerce system. It includes methods for adding, editing, deleting, and repairing categories, as well as handling related SEO URLs, hierarchy, filters, stores, and layouts.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: This class provides functionality for managing product categories in OpenCart, including creating, updating, deleting, and repairing categories, as well as handling SEO URLs, hierarchy, filters, store assignments, and layouts.

classes.name: Category
classes.description: This class provides functionality for managing product categories in OpenCart, including creating, updating, deleting, and repairing categories, as well as handling SEO URLs, hierarchy, filters, store associations, and layouts.

methods.name: addCategory
methods.description: Adds a new category with provided data, handling hierarchy, SEO URLs, filters, store associations, and layout configurations, and returns the newly created category ID.

methods.name: editCategory
methods.description: Updates an existing category identified by category_id with new data, including descriptions, SEO URLs, hierarchy, filters, store associations, and layouts.

methods.name: deleteCategory
methods.description: Deletes a category and all associated descriptions, filters, store links, layouts, SEO URLs, and subtree categories.

methods.name: repairCategories
methods.description: Rebuilds the category hierarchy starting from a specified parent ID, fixing paths and hierarchy consistency.

methods.name: deleteStoresByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes all store associations for a given store ID from the 'category_to_store' table.

methods.name: getStores
methods.description: Retrieves all store IDs associated with a specific category.

methods.name: addLayout
methods.description: Adds a layout configuration for a specific category, store, and layout ID.

methods.name: deleteLayouts
methods.description: Deletes all layout configurations associated with a specific category.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Deletes layout configurations associated with a specific layout ID.

methods.name: deleteLayoutsByStoreId
methods.description: Deletes layout configurations associated with a specific store ID.

methods.name: getLayouts
methods.description: Retrieves all layout configurations for a specific category, returning an array keyed by store ID with layout IDs.

methods.name: getTotalLayoutsByLayoutId
methods.description: Returns the total count of layout associations for a specific layout ID.
